challenge.method: Inspect the no-match case with and without ELSE, guard-type eligibility, the single-branch form, and potential extrapolation from the separate type-guard expression rule in §8.1. Compare the base report’s WITH production as a boundary check.
challenge.results: The named edition documents ordered alternatives in its example, static treatment within a matching branch, optional fallback, and abortion when there is neither a match nor an ELSE. The base report’s WITH production on printed and physical page 12 shows the single guarded sequence. Exact subtype and reassignment edge cases are outside the candidate.

limitations: The conclusion is a report-scoped description of the controls and branch scope. No runtime or compiler behavior was asserted.
